proves.facet: Under one verified Reviewer binding, the test opens and records ordinary CODE rounds, preserves the original sealed finding and remaining IDs, refuses changed/new IDs and refuses beginning beyond the default settings-defined budget without approval. The test exercises CODE begin_review/record_review only; it does not exercise the separate MEMORY count, runtime settings changes, approval attribution, or the record-only unchanged-candidate path.

realizes.rationale: Exercises registered calls under verified Reviewer binding and proves unchanged sealed IDs and limit refusals.

1.note: A bound Reviewer opens and records ordinary CODE BLOCK rounds, retaining the same unresolved sealed ID; changed IDs and the next unapproved begin are refused.
